description: Vizient third-party data contract checklist (POC Lite)

Vendor.description: Legal name of the counterparty providing data or services to Vizient or its affiliate.

VizientEntity.description: The Vizient entity or affiliate that is a party, for example Vizient Inc. or Sg2, LLC.

enumDescriptions.MSA: Master services agreement: umbrella terms that govern later statements of work or orders.
enumDescriptions.SOW: Statement of work: scope, deliverables, term and fees for specific work.
enumDescriptions.Amendment: Amendment: changes, extends or restates an earlier agreement or statement of work.
enumDescriptions.Order Form: Order form: an ordering document for specific products, data or subscriptions.
enumDescriptions.DUA: Data use agreement: terms for access to or use of data.
enumDescriptions.BAA: Business associate agreement: HIPAA terms for handling protected health information.
enumDescriptions.Other: None of the other document types.

ContractIdentifier.description: Agreement, SOW, opportunity or contract number of THIS document.

ExpirationDate.description: Date the term or license period ends. Leave empty if evergreen or not stated.

RenewalTermination.description: Summary of renewal terms, notice periods and termination-for-convenience rights. Empty if not stated. A one-time extension or change of the end date is not a renewal term.

Signatories.description: Names, titles and signature dates of all signers.

ParentAgreementReference.description: Any other agreement this document incorporates by reference, amends or is governed by, with number and date. Empty if none. Only a specific agreement the document names counts; a statement that the document is stand-alone is not a reference.

Right_InternalAnalytics_Judgment.description: Judgment for 'Internal Analytics': May the data be used for internal reporting and analysis? Use 'Not Addressed' if the document does not explicitly address this. Never infer from silence.

enumDescriptions.Permitted: The document explicitly allows this without material conditions.
enumDescriptions.Conditional: The document allows or requires this only under stated conditions, limits or approvals.
enumDescriptions.Not Addressed: The document does not explicitly address this. Never infer from silence.

Right_InternalAnalytics_Conditions.description: Conditions, limits or approvals that apply to 'Internal Analytics'. Empty if none.

Right_InternalAnalytics_Clause.description: Verbatim text of the clause that governs 'Internal Analytics'. Prefer the clause that states the rule over a sentence that only refers to it. Empty if Not Addressed.

Right_Geographic_Judgment.description: Judgment for 'Geographic / Offshore': Does the contract limit where the data may be stored or accessed from, for example data residency, United States-only storage or access, or an offshore access rule? Use 'Not Addressed' if the document does not explicitly address this. Never infer from silence.

enumDescriptions.Permitted: The contract expressly allows the data to be stored or accessed from any location, including offshore.
enumDescriptions.Prohibited: The contract itself limits storage or access to the United States or another named location, or forbids offshore storage or access.
enumDescriptions.Conditional: The contract allows storage or access outside the stated location only with approval or under stated conditions.
enumDescriptions.Not Addressed: The contract states no rule on where the data is stored or accessed from. Never infer from silence.

Right_Geographic_Conditions.description: Conditions, limits or approvals that apply to 'Geographic / Offshore'. Empty if none.

Right_Geographic_Clause.description: Verbatim text of the clause that governs 'Geographic / Offshore'. Prefer the clause that states the rule over a sentence that only refers to it. Empty if Not Addressed.
